subject: math
cluster: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes by properties of their lines and angles

items.prompt:
A triangle with a $90^\circ$ angle is a
A) right triangle
B) acute triangle
C) obtuse triangle
D) square

A triangle with all angles under $90^\circ$ is
A) acute
B) right
C) obtuse
D) square

A triangle with all sides equal is
A) equilateral
B) scalene
C) right
D) obtuse

A triangle with one angle over $90^\circ$ is
A) acute
B) right
C) obtuse
D) equilateral

A quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides is a
A) parallelogram
B) triangle
C) pentagon
D) circle

A triangle with two equal sides is
A) isosceles
B) scalene
C) right
D) equilateral

A four-sided shape with exactly one pair of parallel sides is a
A) trapezoid
B) square
C) triangle
D) pentagon

Is a square a parallelogram?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only big ones
D) Only tilted ones
